selection: MLP epoch by validation macro-F1; configuration by mean validation macro-F1 over five seeds; never best test seed
learning_curve: fixed validation/test; nested class-stratified group subsets; original hyperparameters; five subset/head seeds
calibration: top-label equal-width ECE10 primary, ECE15 sensitivity; temperature fitted only on validation NLL; exploratory calibrated variant
bootstrap: 2000 paired hierarchical draws: shared seeds and class-stratified test rows
test_reuse: Existing test already inspected in prior work. New comparisons are exploratory, not a fresh confirmatory holdout.
